known_limitations: The minimum-width device scales by 1.6990672278783523 when W doubles from 0.22 um to 0.44 um. A hand-written native two-device deck reproduces the pipeline exactly; the documented 1.5-to-2.5 metamorphic band is deliberately broader than the initially tried 1.7 floor.
The fixture omits ad/as/pd/ps, which GF180 treats as zero; the OP current is covered but junction-capacitance-dependent AC/transient behavior is not.
The typical fixture does not establish I/O-device, skew-corner, passive or mismatch conformance.
